titles.title: Black Spot No. 3

description: A black rectangular shape rises diagonally through this abstract composition. It contrasts with a longer, slender white form that echoes the black shape's directionality. In the background, bulbous forms in shades of blue, green, and yellow frame the central black and white shapes.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
